title: chat/fed: Space addMembers vs Peer/groupUpdate conflict
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md:1324 says adding a Space member 'triggers outbound Peer/groupUpdate notifications in federated deployments'. But Peer/groupUpdate is defined only for group chats, and draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00 §Space-Level Federation says Space-level operations are not proactively federated. Reconcile (likely: drop Peer/groupUpdate from the Space/set rationale). Found writing jmap-chat-vc-guide.md §6 (bead dqe3).
